waivers.reason: The branch requires otherwise synchronized head instances to report different internal output phases while all heads are valid. Legal top-level stimulus does not directly control per-head phase state.
waivers.reachability_evidence: phase_mismatch_o is derived only from per_head_step_o differences inside the generated head loop; all heads receive the same ctrl_i start/layer/tile configuration.
waivers.verification_impact: A real head phase divergence remains observable through phase_mismatch_o and output suppression, but this defensive path is not a legal functional coverage target.
waivers.notes: Do not apply an exclusion until the RTL owner confirms that independent head phase divergence is structurally unreachable.

waivers.reason: The integrated softmax divider uses unsigned divide only; signed divide and remainder opcode combinations cannot be selected through the MHA8 top-level interface.
waivers.verification_impact: These generic divider modes require a separate ita_serdiv unit-level verification target if they are owned and intended for reuse.
waivers.notes: Integration-level waiver only; it does not establish standalone divider correctness.

waivers.reason: The MHA8 softmax integration does not expose divider flush behavior.
waivers.verification_impact: Flush behavior is outside the current MHA8 integration contract and must be verified separately if the divider is reused elsewhere.
waivers.notes: Do not automatically exclude this path from a standalone ita_serdiv coverage target.

waivers.reason: The guarded AV stall requires division to remain incomplete after QK has finished and AV input reaches soft_addr_div_i. Maximum-rate legal QK stimulus completed division before this window.
waivers.reachability_evidence: coverage_stall_boundaries drives continuous valid at one accepted beat per cycle with tile_s=4 and tile_p=4; ITA_STALL_TARGET_SUMMARY reported softmax_div=0.
waivers.verification_impact: If a future divider implementation or parameter set has higher latency, this path may become reachable and the waiver must be rejected.
waivers.notes: Targeted simulation evidence exists, but parameter-level proof is still required before approval.

waivers.reason: The integrated ten-divider consumer sustained the maximum legal QK producer rate, so ongoing_soft_q did not reach SoftFifoDepth and the physical softmax FIFO full flag remained low.
waivers.reachability_evidence: coverage_stall_boundaries reported softmax_fifo_stall=0 and softmax_full=0 under continuous-valid tile_s=4/tile_p=4 QK traffic.
waivers.verification_impact: This is configuration-specific. Reducing NumDiv, changing divider latency, or changing FIFO depth can make the path reachable.
waivers.notes: Do not approve without confirming the throughput inequality for the integrated parameters.

waivers.reason: The controller stalls source progress when ongoing_q reaches FifoDepth, preventing the physical output FIFO from asserting full under legal output backpressure.
waivers.reachability_evidence: coverage_stall_boundaries reported output_stall=1 and output_full=0 while per_head_ready_i was held low until the controller capacity guard fired.
waivers.verification_impact: The full flag remains a defensive implementation path; FIFO overflow protection is verified through the controller stall instead.
waivers.notes: A unit-level fifo_v3 target may still need to cover full independently of MHA8 integration.

reachable_gaps_not_waived.reason: These are reset-driven transitions and remain targeted coverage gaps until mid-transaction reset requirements are decided. QK->Idle is not a normal SingleAttention completion path; normal SingleAttention is QK->AV->Idle.
